text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: One day, at Pecorine's request, {0} visited the royal castle prison to meet with the captured Kaiser Insight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}はある日ぺコリーヌの依頼で、
捕縛した覇瞳皇帝との面会のため王城を訪れていた。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: I was wondering who was here to show their faces... Is there something the three of you want from me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰が顔を見せに来たのかと思ったら……
何か用でもあるのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: There is... Or so I thought. If I'd known you were reduced to such an empty shell, I wouldn't have bothered to come here, Your Majesty. I would have never expected to receive such a weak gaze from you of all people.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ある……
はずだったのだがな。
抜け殻と知っていれば
わざわざ足を運ぶまでもなかったよ、
陛下。
アナタがそんな目をするようになるなんてね。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: There's something I wanted to ask you, too, but I believe you will not answer it. The tone of your voice tells me so eloquently that you won't even try to smooth things over as it is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も貴方には聞きたいことがありましたが、
どうやらそれには答えてもらえないようですね。
取り繕いもしない声色が、
雄弁にそう語っていますよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: It's up to you to decide how you want to proceed. There's no need to rush, the reason why this world won't find its closure will appear before you of its own accord.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どう判断しようが
あなたたちの勝手よ。
焦らずとも、
この世界が終わらない理由なら
自ずとあなたたちの前に現れるわ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: The identity of who this "it" is will also become clear in due time. Personally speaking, I don't find it that interesting of a topic to talk over...
text_block_list.orig_text:
『それ』が何者なのかも、
いずれ分かるでしょう。
私の口から語るほどのことではないだけよ……

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: As expected of Your Majesty. Even in a lowly status like that of a prisoner, your insight, the source of your divine strategy, is still strong. Without even moving a muscle, you can easily see through our intentions.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすがは陛下。
囚人となっても神算鬼謀の源たる洞察力は健在だな。
身動き一つせずに、
こちらの目的まで看破してしまうか。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Quite the carefree way of making fun of me, Chris. If you planned to come here merely to check your own deductions, surely you knew it was a waste of time already?
text_block_list.orig_text:
随分と馬鹿にしてくれるわね、
クリス。
結果の確認に来るだけなら、
時間の無駄だと分かっていたんじゃなくて？

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: The same should be true for you, Mana. We both knew this would happen when we tried to guess each other's thoughts and demonstrate the hypothesis we derived.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは貴方も同じはずですよ、
真那。
お互いが相手の思考を推察し、
導き出した仮説の実証を行う場で、
こんな結果に終わることも、
私たちは理解していました。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Still, the reason why I couldn't help but come here despite knowing it'd be pointless is because we're part of this "Seven Crowns" group. From what I've heard, we used to be comrades.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでもこうして来ずにいられなかったのは、
同じ七冠とやらのよしみというヤツかな。
聞いた話だと
我々は元は仲間だったそうではないか。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...A foolish and pointless act.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……心底くだらないわね。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Well, there's also the fact the real Princess asked me to escort the boy right here. Just in case, she provided him with the most luxurious bodyguards in the world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
坊やに付いていってほしいと
本当の『陛下』に頼まれてしまったのもあるがね。
万が一のための、
世界一豪勢な護衛だよ、
我々は。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Despite the fact that you're still connected to that mana draining device, the original Eustiana hasn't lowered her guard against you yet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
装置に繋がれているとはいえ、
本来のユースティアナは
貴方に対してまだ警戒を解いていないのですよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Hmph, how unnecessarily shrewd... That princess doesn't even understand that nothing is going to happen.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふん、
小賢しいったらないわ……
何も起きるわけがないのも
理解できてないのね、
あのお姫さまは。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: ...That's all I have to say. We'll be taking our leave. It seems the young lady's worries were just unfounded.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……話は以上だ。
我々は失礼するよ。
あのお嬢ちゃんの心配は杞憂に過ぎなかったようだ。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Yes. It also seems that no matter the topic at hand, we're all on the same page as it is. Chris and I will leave first, {0}. We'll meet again later when you're done.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
ここからは何を語ろうとも平行線ですから。
クリスと私は先に出ています。
また後で会いましょう。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Farewell, Your Majesty! The next time we meet... well, it will probably be in the middle of a fierce battle that will turn this entire world upside down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さらばだ陛下！　
次に会う時は……
そうだな、
文字通り
世界がひっくり返るような激戦の最中だろう！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: ...Until then, make sure to stay healthy, alright?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……それまで、
壮健であってくれよ？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: It's not like anything's going to happen to me as long as I'm here anyway...
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうせ
ここにいる限りは何も起きないわよ……

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: I don't have as many naive emotional feelings for you as Chris does, but even for me this comes as a disappointment. You have no intention of speaking, let alone living-...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私はクリスほど
貴方へのウェットな感情は持ち合わせていませんが、
そんな私でも、
どうやら少し残念に思っているようです。
貴方は会話の意思どころか、
生き──

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Neneka... Hurry up and zip that mouth of yours.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ネネカ……
さっさとその口を閉じなさい。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...I will. I have no more words left to spare to someone who has seemingly reached a dead end. Goodbye, Mana.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうしますよ。
行き止まりで立ち止まった者に、
もうかける言葉は持ち合わせていません。
さようなら、
真那。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. It seems they've finally left.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
やっと出ていったわね。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: So? You've been left alone with this pitiful prisoner... what are you planning to do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
で？　
一人残ったあなたは
哀れな虜囚に
一体何をしようというの？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...What could that be?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……何かしら？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...That's such a ridiculous act even for my predictions. I don't need it. Such a pitiful thing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……予測の中でも底抜けにくだらない。
いらないわ、
そんなもの。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Kyaru... I thought that girl betrayed me when she found her next person to desperately cling to, but now she's showing me charity? Perhaps as soon as you all won, she started to think of me as a pet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
キャル……
次にすがる相手を見つけて私を裏切ったかと思えば、
お次は施し？　
勝った途端に
愛玩動物同然に思えてきたのかしら。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Not only did she physically create something embodying her change of heart, but she even had the audacity to have you carry it to me, what a nice touch.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふざけた変心の結果を
物理的に作り出しただけでなく、
それをあなたに運ばせるなんて、
当てつけとしては上出来よ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: If she really wants to own that guilt, she shouldn't have betrayed me in the first place. Truly, what a foolish girl.
text_block_list.orig_text:
後ろめたくなるくらいなら、
裏切らなければよかったじゃない。
本当に
愚かしい子。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: This world is going to reach another boring dead end... I can tell merely by looking at you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
世界はまだつまらない行き止まりのままというのは、
あなたを見て分かったわ……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: I'll tell you in advance that I have no intention of granting your or that princess's wishes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
先に言っておくけど、
あなたやあのお姫さまの
願いを叶えるつもりはないの。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: In that case, shall I predict what you're about to say? Or do you want to tell me yourself? "If you can..."
text_block_list.orig_text:
だったら言ってあげましょうか？
それとも自分で言いたい？　
あなたは
できるなら──

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...That's the one thing I'd rather never have to hear. If you're going to say that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……それだけは御免被るわ。
そんなことをされるくらいなら……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Let's talk about you, rather than me. The fool who spends his time in a world that doesn't change, am I right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
一切の変化がない時間を過ごす私よりも、
あなたはどうなのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: From what I can see, you've been deprived of your achievements and feats by the princess, and you're just living a normal life in a world where nothing changes, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
その様子だと
お姫さまに功績を奪われ、
何も変わらない世界でただ日常を過ごしているだけなのでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Is the "god-slaying hero" in front of me truly satisfied with such an outcome?
text_block_list.orig_text:
神殺しの英雄は、
そんな結果で満たされているの？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: No, I, as a god, was indeed killed... I am as good as dead. You can see that just by looking at my current state, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいえ、
神としての私は殺された……
死んだも同然よ。
この有様を見れば分かるでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: To you, this is merely a natural outcome from your actions. The most humiliating thing is to be looked at with such a look that shows neither pity nor contempt.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたにしてみたら当然の結果ですものね。
その憐憫も侮蔑もない目を向けられるのが、
最も屈辱を覚えるわ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: I once shattered your soul... I killed you back then. How could you not feel anything towards me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は
かつてあなたの魂を砕いた……
一度は殺したのが私なのよ。
何も感じてないはずがないわよね？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Therefore the truth here is that you really want to hurt me... No, somewhere in your heart there's a part of you that wants to kill me, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当は
私を思いっきり傷つけたい……
いいえ、
殺したいという気持ちが
心のどこかにあるのよね？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...That's mere sophistry. Even if that's not what you're currently thinking, it must have been different when you were fighting me. You couldn't forgive me for bullying Kyaru and hurting your friends, correct?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……詭弁ね。
今は思ってないとしても、
戦っていた時は違ったはずよ。
キャルを虐げて、
仲間を傷つけた私だけは許せなかったのよね？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: AHAHAHAHA! That's a very simple lie to spot! There's no way you wouldn't notice that after you had just returned from the brink of death! ...Stop turning a blind eye.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはははっ！　
なんて簡単な嘘をつくのかしら！
死の淵からよみがえっておいて、
気づいていないはずがないわ！
……見て見ぬ振りはやめなさい。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Even if you are the polar opposite of us Seven Crowns and live only with an altruistic spirit, you cannot erase the fear and anger you feel towards those who threaten your own survival...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いくらあなたが私たち七冠と対極の、
利他の精神だけで生きているような人間でも、
自らの生存を脅かされた存在への恐怖や怒りは消し去れない……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: The only way to forget those feelings is to erase the one who generated them in you. So you've got only one way to do that, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
忘れるには、
その感情の原因を消し去るしかない。
だったら
方法は一つよね？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: You cannot save me. I don't want to be saved by you. We're unable to connect. We can’t understand each other.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたは私を救えない。
あなたに私は救われたくない。
私たちは繋がらない。
分かり合えないのよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: I've already used all the words I had to spare with you, I'm done... And by that I don't mean "you", but the you from before who keeps appearing before me no matter how many times I defeat you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうあなたとは
言葉を尽くした後なの……
あなたじゃないあなた、
何度倒しても現れたかつてのあなたと。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sick of it. In a world where possibilities are already limited and we're reaching another dead end, it's so pointless to keep observing the same answers...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うんざりしてるわ。
可能性を制限された行き詰った世界で、
代わり映えしない答えを観測し続けるのがどれほど虚しいか……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: You will gain nothing by coming here. So just stick your sword into me and take home a failure that can't even be used as a proper offering.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここに来ても、
何も起きないわ。
私に剣を突き立てて、
その供物にすら成り得ない出来損ないを持って帰りなさい。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Isn't it admirable that you're standing up for a traitorous failure like Kyaru? Would you allow her to change even how you think merely to carry out your good deeds?
text_block_list.orig_text:
人を裏切るような出来損ないを庇い立てるなんてご立派よね？
自分たちへの善意のためなら、
あの子の翻意を認めてしまうの？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: In the end, you can only see things in your own self-righteous way. Understand that there are people who don't value salvation for themselves. That you cannot save.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたも所詮は
独善的な見方しかできないのよ。
自分にとっての救済が
その価値を持たない相手もいると
理解しなさい。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: The will of somebody else... That's something I will never accept, especially if it's you and that child. You want to help me? I'll never accept such conceit.
text_block_list.orig_text:
他者の、
特に
あなたやあの子の意思を取り入れるのは嫌なの。
私を助ける？　
そんな思い上がりは決して受け入れない。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: If you really want me to listen to your whims, you'll have to call and use Noemu's power to fiddle with my head and turn me into an obedient puppet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしても言うことを聞かせたいなら、
ノウェムの力で頭をいじって、
従順な操り人形にでもすることね。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: That's the only way you'll achieve what you want. So give up, okay? Just go and savor this latest bad ending while having a blast.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなやり方でしかできないのよ。
諦めなさい？
バッドエンドを味わい尽くして、
狂ってしまえばいいわ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: You can't continue or quit this game... You can only repeat it over and over from the same save point. An eternal dead-end story...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゲームを続けることもやめることもできない……
同じセーブポイントからしか繰り返せない、
行き止まりの物語……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: That's the beauty of the game. The end of this journey of mine will be one where I've overcome all obstacles before me, not only you nor Akira...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それが私の得たもの。
あなたや晶だけでなく
あらゆる障害を排除して辿り着いた旅の終点……

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't it frustrating to have someone speak of the suffering you've experienced as something beautiful? As a game?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なんて、
自分が傷つけられたことを奇麗なものとして
語られてしまうのは
苛立つでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...I hope this is not a foolish attempt at drawing me in with your clique. When we're such polar opposites, I can't help but feel disgust.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私まで取り込もうとしないでくれるかしら。
ここまで対極だと、
どうしても嫌悪感が抑えきれなくなるわね。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: A fool who never changes his ignorance when he sees the marble-patterned liquid made from mixing oil and water and rejoices at its existence. That's who you are.
text_block_list.orig_text:
水と油をかき混ぜてできたマーブル模様の液体を見て、
一つになったと喜ぶ無知を改めない愚か者。
それがあなたよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: You don't even try to make use of your accumulated knowledge. You prioritize your will and emotions instead. You save people by acting like, you BELIEVE you saved them... You're an eyesore down to the bottom of your very hearth.
text_block_list.orig_text:
蓄えた知識を生かそうともせず、
意思や感情を優先する。
それで人を救える、
救ったつもりでいる……
心の底から目障りよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...I've grown tired with those attempts at destroying your facade, and there's nothing more I want to tell you, or hear from you for that matter, but... Ah, there was one last thing I wanted to say.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
あなたたちの抗いを挫くための仕込みで疲れたし、
もう聞かせたい話も、
聞きたい話もないけど……
ああ、
一つだけあったわ。
言っておきたいことが。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: You can't let someone who refuses mutual understanding live. There can only be one standard and principle in the world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
相互理解を拒んだ相手を生かしておいてはダメよ。
世界の基準、
主義は
一つしか存在し得ないの。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Even if you're hellbent on understanding and acknowledging me, are there any chances your friends will do the same and forgive me? Of course not. So there's only one thing you can do for me right now: erase me from this world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分だけが私を認めるつもりだとしても、
仲間が許す可能性は？
ゼロに決まってるわ。
だから
あなたにできる私への施しは一つだけ。
私を
この世界から消し去ることよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: When I first met you, I had so much fun erasing you...♪ The look on your face when you and your three friends, who were desperately resisting, succumbed to overwhelming power was amazing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も
最初の頃は、
あなたを消し去るのがすごく楽しかった……♪
必死に抵抗する仲間たちもろとも、
圧倒的な力の前に屈する時の表情も最高だったわ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: If you can't remember, just imagine... the burning city, me toying with your exhausted friends over and over and over and over again...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
思い出せないなら想像しなさい……
燃え盛る街、
力尽きた仲間を何度も、
何度も何度も何度も何度も弄ぶ私を……！

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: You want that fate to stop, don't you? But you can't do that... I wonder why?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やめさせたいでしょう？
でも
あなたにはそれができない……
何故かしらね？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...It's because you're thinking about saving me. You're able to think so naively because you live on due to a single miracle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私を助けようなんて考えるからよ。
たった一度の奇跡の上で生きているから、
あなたはそんな甘い考えでいられるの。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: And this isn't only about your friends. What about the other people who got caught up in this mess? I'm sure there are a lot of people who hate me even if they can't put a face to the name just yet. And not just in Astrum, but in reality too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに仲間だけじゃないわ。
巻き込まれた他人は？
きっと私を憎んでも憎み切れない人が、
たくさんいる。
アストルムだけじゃないわ。
現実にだって。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: There will always be people who want to vent their anger directly to me if they find out the truth about this whole situation. What right do you have to stop their wishes?
text_block_list.orig_text:
真実を知れば
私に直接怒りをぶつけたい人が必ずいる。
それをあなたが止める権利は
どこにあるのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: If there are people who can only be saved by completely erasing my existence, how will you help them? Are you planning to save both me and them? ...You're the peak of arrogance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私という存在を完全に消し去らないと救われない人がいたら、
あなたはどう助けるの？　
私と彼ら、
どちらも救うつもり？
……本当は傲慢なのよ、
あなたは。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: You'll let me live even if your choice means all of humanity will suffer? You're not that great, yet you still act as the representative of humankind here. That's impressive! You've already failed once, you know? Who could trust such a person to represent anybody?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたの選択で
人類全体が苦しむとしても
私を生かす？
そこまで偉くもないくせにヒトの代表気取りとは大したものね！
現に
一度失敗してるのよ？　
そんな人間を誰が信用するのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...Don't give me an answer that isn't one of the options I have prepared for you. Try telling this story to your friends. I'm sure... that only a very small number of them will give you the same answer you did to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私の用意した選択肢にない答えを口にしないで。
この話、
あなたの仲間に話してみなさい。
きっと
同じ答えを口にする人間は……
極少数でしょうね。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...I'm tired of messing with you, so you can just go home now. Your answers are boring because you keep evading from actually answering me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いじり飽きたし、
もう帰っていいわよ。
あなたの答えは
逃げ回るばかりでつまらないわ。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: Next time... Yes, when the world is destroyed and everything returns to square one, we'll meet again. Do your best to struggle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
次は……
そうね、
世界が滅んで
全てが振り出しに戻ったら、
また会いましょう。
せいぜい必死にあがきなさい。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: ...Still not planning to give up, are you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……また諦めないのね、
あなたは。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The words that Kaiser Insight muttered quietly were not heard by {0}, and disappeared without reaching anyone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
覇瞳皇帝が小さくこぼした言葉は、
{0}に聞かれることはなく、
誰にも届かずに消えていったのだった。
